search_text: published ZDI-22-508 ZDI-CAN-15192 Cisco Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2022-03-11 CVE-2015-3269 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-3269 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['Cisco'] ['Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Cisco Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the AMF protocol. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the fmserver user. Fixed in version 11.5(4) or later ['2021-09-10 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2022-03-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] kpc https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-22-508/
title: Cisco Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Cisco Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the AMF protocol. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the fmserver user.
